claude_proposed_widenings.name: SpeciesTraitRecord + passive_grant family
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: UnitRecord only has spell | class_feature | mastery. There is no species_trait kind. Damage Resistance is a passive, permanent trait with no activation cost, no resource, and no rest reset — none of the existing mechanics families (activation, ongoing_effect, on_hit_trigger, etc.) can encode it honestly.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You have Resistance to the damage type determined by your Draconic Ancestry trait.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_resistance with damage_type parameterized by character-creation choice
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The resistance type is not fixed at encoding time — it is determined by the Draconic Ancestry trait choice at character creation. The surface has no mechanism to express 'damage type chosen at character creation' as a parameter on grant_resistance.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Your choice affects your Breath Weapon and Damage Resistance traits... You have Resistance to the damage type determined by your Draconic Ancestry trait.
